summary: Recursive audio network tree walk: reads two child pointers at a2[17] and a2[19] and recurses on each (depth flag 1), aborting with -1 if any subtree walk reports busy/failure; then walks a linked-node chain starting at a2[129], following next-pointers at offset 16 while the node is not yet transform-ready (VertexBufferTransform(this[0xEC] & 4) false). Returns -1 when a ready chain node is found or a subtree walk fails, 0 when the chain terminates.

operations.description: Read the first child pointer stored at a2[17].
If a2[17] is nonzero and the recursive AudioNetworkTreeWalker(a2[17], 1) returns nonzero, return -1 immediately.
Read the second child pointer stored at a2[19].
If a2[19] is nonzero, the a3 flag is nonzero, and the recursive AudioNetworkTreeWalker(a2[19], 1) returns nonzero, return -1 immediately.
Read the linked-node chain pointer stored at a2[129].
If a2[129] is nonzero, traverse the chain while VertexBufferTransform(this[0xEC] & 4) evaluates false.
Follow the next-pointer at offset 16 within the current chain node; return 0 when the chain terminates with a null pointer.
Return -1 when a chain node passes the readiness check, and 0 when the chain ends or no chain was present.

unresolved: Meaning of the a3 flag (depth/mode selector) is not established; it gates only the second child walk.
Semantics of VertexBufferTransform and of the bitmask 4 applied to this[0xEC] are unknown; the readiness condition is opaque.
Layout of the node object (a2) and the linked chain node is unknown; offsets 17, 19, 129 are dword indices from raw source.
